result.summary: 2,590 tiles can move into the World pack (2,435 on another drive get a local on-demand copy; their files stay where they are). It needs 170.7 GB on this drive and takes about 6 min. 2 are left as they are; 0 were moved before.

choices.line: Keeps 2,590 tiles: they move into the World pack as they are, needing 170.7 GB on this Mac. Still needs ThunderBlade (2,437 tiles).

Keeps the 38 tiles with a custom airport and makes 2,554 dynamic: X-Plane draws them from the World pack, draped ahead in flight or built when you fly there. Free space then gives back 74.4 GB on this Mac; the kept tiles need 2.5 GB. 7.9 TB on ThunderBlade is no longer needed (its files are never deleted). 2,402 links to another drive are removed from Custom Scenery; Undo puts them back. 146 of the dynamic tiles were not built by XPTerrainBuilder (or their drive is not connected): they become our drape or build, not the same tile. Still needs ThunderBlade (35 tiles).

Makes all 2,592 tiles dynamic: X-Plane draws them from the World pack, draped ahead in flight or built when you fly there. Free space then gives back 75.9 GB on this Mac. 8.1 TB on ThunderBlade is no longer needed (its files are never deleted). 2,437 links to another drive are removed from Custom Scenery; Undo puts them back. 147 of the dynamic tiles were not built by XPTerrainBuilder (or their drive is not connected): they become our drape or build, not the same tile. No other drive is needed afterwards.
